I work competently in 5 others\"","dimension":"language breadth","description":"This captures how many programming languages and how prominently Go is presented in the candidate’s language profile.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I have architected agentic tooling comprising Go back-end infrastructure and Python agents\" vs no comparable claim","dimension":"agentic systems experience","description":"This captures explicit experience building agentic tooling and the Go/Python systems central to the job posting.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I have delivered production functionality built on modern AI systems\" vs no comparable claim","dimension":"AI experience","description":"This captures direct experience with AI systems relevant to the role’s preferred qualifications and responsibilities.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I have conducted formal security assessments\" vs \"I take part in capture-the-flag competitions\"","dimension":"security assessment experience","description":"This captures substantive professional security-evaluation work versus hobbyist offensive security practice.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I use Python daily\" vs \"I am an experienced Python developer\"","dimension":"Python emphasis","description":"This captures how strongly the letter foregrounds Python as a professional strength for the role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"reducing manual security workload through well-built automation\" vs \"designed and delivered automation for vulnerability report triage\"","dimension":"automation specificity","description":"This captures whether the letter speaks in general terms about automation or names a concrete security automation use case.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"attacker instincts\" vs \"maintain offensive proficiency\"","dimension":"security mindset","description":"This captures how explicitly the letter frames the candidate’s security orientation and offensive-security practice.","winner":"B"}]}
